[b][i]IA peacekeepers in Tallislandic waters[/i][/b]

[b]| - |[/b] [i]The ICGO recently had a meeting discussing the Tallislandic civil war, and their alleged violations to human rights. The meeting resulted in a poll being made to ensure that the waters around tallisland are safe not only for cargo ships, but also to ensure that no two nations with unofficial declarations of war can fight each other, and if so, they don't hit civilian infrastructure. 

[b]|---[/b] Around 13:30 (HST-5) the IPF got a call from the ICGO. Their very small maritime ship (and I mean very small, only a couple dozen) left from port Nishazi, New Arenenge, and began its sail. They were stopped by the Wonnic navy for half an hour, and then were let free. At 15:00 they refilled at port Bronsburg, B.R. Bob, and then a few minutes later, started to patrol the sea. The peacekeeping force are equipped with 9 Arenese frigates from the 1980's, partially de-militarized.  3 transport ships, partially de-militarized, and 3 medical boats. They arrived 16:00 in Tallislandic waters. They were tasked with reporting any unorthodox activity to the surrounding nations and the IA informational centers.[/i]

All parties involve agree to, as the constitution define,s hold General Snap Elections within 30 days of this event occuring

[sub][b]The Infanstructure Improvement Act[/b][/sub]

[spoiler=Infanstructure Improvement Act]

[b]An act to[/b]

To authorize appropriations for the current fiscal year (2026-2027), and for the fiscal year following for the next 5 years, for outside-of-budget funding to infrastructure projects. 

[b]Exercising the popular will of the people of the Second Flouesch Republic, the Revolutionary Council of State is to enact the following[/b]

Section 1: Appropriations for the fiscal years of 2026-2027, 2027-2028, 2028-2029, 2029-2030, and 2030-2031

 | 1.1 The amount of the appropriations for the following proposal will not exceed 20 billion dollars, if it is needed, a simple amendment to this bill can be made with a simple majority vote of the Staatsrot.

 |1.2 The following agency to handle and oversee these appropriations will be the National Infrastructure Improvement Board, which will be under control of the Deparment of Rail and Transportation, it will be disbanded after the exporation of funding.
 
 |1.3 At the beginning of every fisical year the board will produce a report to the Revolutionary Council of State regarding the improvements it has made and how much of its allocated funding it has used so far.

|1.4 The Revolutionary Council of State may at any point, before January 1st 2023 extend funding for this agency.

Section 2: Purpose 

 |2.1 The purpose of the National Infrastructural Improvement Act is as follows

  ||2.1a To electrify all remaining non-electrified railroads in the Republic  

  ||2.1b To expand the high-speed rail coverage across the Republic, primarily to the cities of Hettesyver and Remsyrl.

  ||2.1c To obtain new rolling stock for all Floueschian Railways, whether that be foreign rolling stock, or domestically produced rolling stock

 ||2.1d To expand rail coverage in general to all remaining non-connected cities in the republic, providing an effective alternative for southern floueschia. This will involve the construction of a new railhub in Wremsei

|2.2 The secondary purpose of the National Infrastructural Improvement Act is to improve public utilities such as water, internet cables and energy. While also establishing speed cameras on all non-inter-republic roads across the Nation.

[b][sub]Resolution of denunciation of the activity of the Neue Republik and United States of Oceanice against the Revolutionaries of Tallisland and Authorization of Floueschian Involvement[/sub][/b]

[spoiler=Resolution of denunciation of the activity of the Neue Republik and United States of Oceanice against the Revolutionaries of Tallisland and Authorization of Floueschian Involvement]

[b]An act to[/b]

To denounce the hostile actions committed by the Neue Republik and the United States of Oceanice against the Revolutionaries of Tallisland, and to authorize the involvement of the Department of State Security, Department of Foreign Affairs, and Department of National Defense and National Peoples Army

[b]Exercising the popular will of the people of the Second Flouesch Republic, the Revolutionary Council of State declares the following[/b]

Section 1: Declaration

Recognizing, that the anti-principalist revolutionaries of Tallisland are the rightful government at this moment of the Tallislandic Republic, given that the current government has violated the rights of man, suppressed democratic opposition, and popular sovereignty. 

Whereas, the United States of Oceanice, and the Neue Republik have gone out of their way against all possible reason or regard to support the tryannical government currently in control of most of the Tallislandic Republic

Recognizing, that the actions of these two states, which are tyrannical and opposed to all foundations of the Flouesch Republic, have not only put the sovereignty of the people of Tallisland at great risk, but by exploding military buildup and tensions in the general vicinity of the Flouesch Republic has endangered our sovereignty and territorial integreity, along with our economic intrests and trade within the region.

Dennounces, firmly, the actions of the Neue Republic and United States of Oceanice and commits the Second Flouesch Republic to defensive activities within Tallisland and the general vicinity of the Republic regarding this situation.

Section 2: Authorization

|2.1 The Department of Foreign Affairs is hereby ordered by the Revolutionary Council of State to begin to undergo the following actions

 ||2.1a Inform the governments of the Neue Republik and the United States of Oceanice that diplomatic relations between them and the Second Flouesch Republic are hereby suspended in accordance with Section 1

 ||2.1b Begin the expulsion of diplomatic personnel from the Neue Republic and the United States of Oceanice from the borders of the Second Flouesch Republic, there vacant embassies will be placed under direct gaurd by the Internal Revolutionary Gaurd and will not be entered in accordance with International Law

 ||2.1c Inform the ambassadors of both countries that they have been formally recalled from their duties, and to begin the destruction or evacuation of all sensitive documents.

|2.2 The provisions of subsection 2, 1 will expire at the formal end of the crisis in Tallisland

|2.3 Given that the Thyvean Government has shown willingness to cooperate and assist the Second Flouesch Republic, the provisions of all acts prohibiting diplomatic relations between the two are hereby repealed by this body, and the Thyvean Government may return to there embassy in Floueschia.  

|2.4 The First Consul, First Tribune, and the heads of the Department of Defense, Department of State Security, and National Peoples Army are hereby authorized to use all necessary and appropriate force in resolving the cirsis in Thailsand.

||2.4a If the situation escalates, a provision will be included for the First Consul to be allowed to preemptively declare a State of National Emergency and undertake authority delegated to his or her office by the War Authority clause of the Constitution of the Second Flouesch Republic.

This motion is put to the floor of the Revolutionary Council of State for voting.

[spoiler=Republic Defender 2036 Act]

Significantly expand and improve both the defensive and offensive capabilities of the National Volleksarméi, as well as its organizational and operational situation, given the extremely tense international situation, and the growing need for its deployment in the defense of the ideas of reason, man, and republicanism.

[b]Exercising the popular will of the people of the Second Flouesch Republic, the Revolutionary Council of State is to enact the following[/b]

Section 1: Appropriations

|1.1 The appropriations for the Republic Defender 2035 Act will amount to 50 billion in total for the fiscal year of 2026-2027, with an additional 10 billion being contributed to it by the National Government annually for the next 10 years. Adding up to a total of 150 billion contributed.

||1.1a The use of the appropriated money by the Department of National Defense, National Peoples Army, and other related bodies is to follow stricly what is defined in this bill.

||1.1b The defined and allowed use of this money is:

Procurement of New Equipment

The construction of new military bases in specified locations, and approved by local councils

The construction of 3 new training schools for officers

The construction of 10 new training camps for the use of the National Peoples Army

|1.2 Every 2 years for the duration of, the Inspector General of the National Peoples Army must form a report on the usage of funds appropriated to the Revolutionary Council of State's Efficiency Inspection Commission

Section 2: Authorization of Foreign Acquisitions

2.1 The Department of Defense, National Peoples Army, and related entities are hereby authorized by the Revolutionary Council of State to explore options in purchasing and or licensing of foreign military equipment.

2.2 If the Deparment of Defense, National Peoples Army, and related entities come to a deal with a forigen nation, they will not need the consent of the Revolutionary Council of State to close it, such consent is deferred to the First Consul, until the experation of funding for this act in 2036, after which point authority on foreign acuistions will be handed back over to the Revolutionary Council of State.
